name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Ukraine hits Russia's largest online marketplace, hurting small businesses and bringing the war home
changes.summary: The Ukrainian attacks on the sprawling Russian warehouses produced stark images, with massive pillars of black smoke rising above fires that raged at facilities of Wildberries, the country's biggest online retailer and its equivalent of Amazon.

changes.title: Trump Tariff Fight Stalls Russia Sanctions Bill Championed by Lindsey Graham
changes.summary: A bipartisan bill championed by the late Senator Lindsey Graham has become mired in a dispute over expanding President Trump’s tariff power.

changes.title: Russia and Ukraine Trade Deadly Blows With Missiles and Drones
changes.summary: Ukrainian strikes set fire to warehouses and other sites in Russia, and Russian bombing rocked Ukraine’s capital, as the two countries escalated an air campaign.

changes.title: A New Target for Ukraine’s Long-Range Attacks: Russia’s Version of Amazon
changes.summary: Kyiv is escalating its air war by striking commercial warehouses, trying to bring the conflict closer to home for ordinary Russians.

changes.title: Ukraine targets Russian online retailer Wildberries
changes.summary: Ukrainian long-range drones targeted large warehouses belonging to Wildberries, Russia’s equivalent of Amazon, which sells military equipment like body armor and drone parts, but mainly serves as a place for regular Russians to sell their goods. President Zelenskyy said the warehouses are “involved in supplying the Rus.

changes.title: Firing of Ukraine’s Top General Signals the End of an Era
changes.summary: Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi, who commanded crucial battles, oversaw an expansion of drone warfare against Russia, but many Ukrainians want even more.

changes.title: Ukraine fires 400 drones toward Moscow as Zelenskyy grapples with protests
changes.summary: The blitz came hours after Russia bombarded Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities with ballistic missiles in a relentless cycle of tit-for-tat strikes.

changes.title: What it's like inside Ukraine during a massive Russian ballistic missile attack
changes.summary: Russia targeted Kyiv, Ukraine, in one of its largest missile assaults of the war over the weekend, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. CBS News' Aidan Stretch has the latest from Kyiv.

changes.title: Putin meets North Korean foreign minister in diplomatic push
changes.summary: The visit by North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui comes without an obvious occasion, such as a multilateral diplomatic event or state anniversary, and has raised speculation that she may be coordinating a possible visit to Russia by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. (Image credit: Alexander Shcherbak).

changes.title: Russia Batters Kyiv in One of the Largest Missile Assaults of the War
changes.summary: On Saturday, Ukraine hit two warehouses in Russia in strikes that killed at least eight people and injured 62.
